value_unit: per-endpoint provider 429 cooldown remembered across independent calls
separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: Firewalla proves that retry policy needs memory beyond one request: a 429 for one endpoint suppresses subsequent callers without blocking unrelated endpoints. LumiNet rederives the concept around canonical action IDs, bounded secret-free state, context cancellation and existing safety classes rather than copying AGPL code.
invariant: provider cooldown is shared per canonical mutation action across independent calls and state remains bounded
negative_invariant: cooldown must never key on credential-bearing URLs, replay single-attempt mutations, or block unrelated actions
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: AGPL evidence; no donor code copied

separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: The donor test demonstrates the discriminating property that one endpoint can be rate-limited while another remains available. LumiNet encodes the same target-native invariant at action granularity.
invariant: cooldown isolation is observable under two distinct action IDs
negative_invariant: rate-limit memory must not become a global outage switch
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: AGPL test used as behavioral evidence only

value_unit: stale-answer window with refresh coordination and transient-error precedence
separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: CoreDNS shows that stale DNS data is useful only under controlled refresh/failure semantics and that transient SERVFAIL must not shadow a valid positive answer. LumiNet applies the same resilience shape to HTTP DoH caching: successful answers only, stale-if-refresh-error, coalesced miss refresh, bounded lifetime.
invariant: only successful DNS answers become fresh cache authority; stale is served only inside a bounded stale window after refresh failure
negative_invariant: HTTP 5xx/empty bodies must never be cached as successful DNS answers; refresh fanout must not scale with caller count
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: Apache-2.0; semantics adapted target-native

value_unit: bounded cache ownership and independent expiry
separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: CoreDNS makes cache capacity a first-class policy. LumiNet replaces three unbounded DNS maps with one bounded TTL/LRU primitive that clones values at ownership boundaries and supports separate fresh/stale deadlines.
invariant: all in-memory DNS caches have a hard entry bound and atomic expiry/LRU ownership
negative_invariant: caller slice mutation, expired retention, or unbounded key growth must not corrupt/expand cache state
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: Apache-2.0

separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: CoreDNS prefetch testing reinforces that refresh work must be coalesced per cache key. LumiNet validates the same property for concurrent DoH misses without importing the donor prefetch subsystem.
invariant: concurrent misses for the same DNS key share one upstream refresh
negative_invariant: cache-miss storms must not multiply upstream requests
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: Apache-2.0

separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: Se7en distinguishes merely reaching readiness from staying healthy for a meaningful interval. LumiNet adopts that invariant in the generic process supervisor, while preserving the independent rolling failure window and additionally pruning expired history at record/evaluation time.
invariant: short ready-then-crash loops continue escalating backoff; only a stable ready run resets consecutive backoff debt
negative_invariant: readiness alone must not erase crash-loop evidence and expired history must not falsely trip the circuit breaker
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: The donor reinforces snapshot-before-mutation and restoration, but LumiNet already has a stronger single host-network authority with process lock, durable route session, validation, verify, rollback and crash recovery. A donor-shaped proxy service would duplicate authority.
invariant: proxy/routing mutations pass through one snapshot/apply/verify/rollback owner
negative_invariant: UI/service-local proxy mutation must not become a parallel host-network source of truth
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: SecretStore is a useful product-level reminder that credentials must be outside ordinary settings/log state. LumiNet already owns a secret-reference boundary and no donor-specific store is introduced.
invariant: mutation retry/status state stores aggregate counters and canonical action IDs only
negative_invariant: URLs, bearer tokens, request bodies and credentials must not enter retry coordinator state or telemetry
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: MIT

value_unit: periodic actual-vs-declared module-state reconciliation and command-hash no-op avoidance
separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: InviZible repeatedly reconciles observed thread/module/firewall state and avoids needless firewall reapplication when the generated command set is unchanged. LumiNet keeps this as a cross-plane invariant: process state is supervisor-owned, host-network state is transaction-owner-observed, and mutation replay requires explicit reconciliation rather than a second generic state loop.
invariant: actual state is observed by the owner before retry/reapply and unchanged desired state does not create a second authority
negative_invariant: a generic GPL-derived state loop must not bypass existing process, host-network or remote-action owners
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: GPL evidence only; target-native guardrail

value_unit: unique periodic work ownership with exponential backoff and resource constraints
separability: standalone semantic unit or evidence fragment
decision_rationale: The donor validates unique periodic ownership and failure backoff. LumiNet already has a service-owned profile refresh scheduler with due-time/backoff/in-flight ownership and now a remote-action cooldown plane; Android battery/storage constraints are not applicable to the desktop/server daemon.
invariant: one service owns scheduled refresh and concurrent stale snapshots cannot duplicate in-flight refresh
negative_invariant: no second scheduler is introduced and platform-specific battery/storage constraints are not misapplied
migration_impact: additive target-native convergence; no donor-shaped durable migration
license_note: GPL evidence only; no code copied
